statement: The node watches the disputes its peer starts against it and, while the dispute is open, asks for a counter naming the nonce and the head of the newest committed frame of the epoch, restating the ask at every frame of the Entity until the chain says the dispute is over, so that one counter lands inside the floor window (60 + 60 s on testnet). With no co-signed proof of the epoch there is nothing to counter with: the implicit proof is the best state there is. A dispute the node started itself, or one of another epoch, is not countered. Status: the ask is a chain action with the nonce and the head only. The peer's signature over that head, which is what makes it a proof, is kept by the Entity (`proofs`, R-SIGNED-HEADS-ON-THE-WIRE) but the action does not carry it and the Host maps no chain op for it, so no counter reaches the chain yet; the e2e dispute steps are the harness's own until that is wired.

killers.name: R-DISPUTE-WATCH every frame of the Entity restates the counter while the dispute is open
R-DISPUTE-WATCH the dispute being over, or the epoch moving on, ends it
R-DISPUTE-WATCH a dispute Alice started, or one of another epoch, is not the Entity's to counter
R-DISPUTE-WATCH a Host that restarts keeps the dispute and is asked to counter again
